newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Duchess of York takes holiday in Argentina.
newsitem.headline: Duchess of York takes holiday in Argentina.

text.p: Britain's Duchess of York, Sarah Ferguson, arrived in Argentina with her two daughters on Thursday for a holiday at her mother Susan Barrantes' polo ranch home.
"It's a private visit," an official at the British Embassy in Buenos Aires said, referring enquiries to Buckingham Palace.
Ferguson, 37, is the former wife of Queen Elizabeth's second son Prince Andrew, who was a helicopter pilot in the 1982 Falklands War with Argentina.

Local news agencies said she was taken in a private plane to her mother's ranch 300 miles (500 km) south of Buenos Aires. Susan Barrantes, divorced from Ferguson's father, is married to Argentine polo player Hector Barrantes.
